items.summary: STILLWATER, Okla., Aug. 10, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- USA Rare Earth, Inc. (Nasdaq: USAR) (the Company), (USAR), a rare earth, critical minerals and advanced materials company, today announced its financial and operational results for the second quarter and six months ended June 30, 2026.
